name: Reduce, Reuse, Reconcile
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.

narrative.details:
I have a favor to ask of someone, and you look helpful!

You see this baby here? Ain't she a beaut? This is my newest racer, designed and built all by myself, because SOMEONE wouldn't help. I plan on taking this to the races in Thousand Needles, but it needs a little extra kick.

Now, I'm too handsome to be a goblin, and I know better than to trust their tech, but I know the Venture Co struck liquid gold over at the lake. I'm sure they won't mind if you, erm, borrowed some? They won't even notice!
narrative.objectives: Acquire 5 Drums of Crude Oil from the Venture Co. operations at Lake Nazferiti, then return to Knaz Blunderflame in Stranglethorn Vale.
